compute.basis: Synthetic N=50 graphs with a few hundred Monte Carlo repetitions of spectral init + Lloyd iterations are tiny; main cost is installing Julia and re-implementing/adapting the repo's simulation and Γ metric to match the exact protocol.

blockers: Repo is Julia and may not exactly reproduce the table's Monte Carlo protocol (number of repetitions, seeds, spectral regularization λreg) without reverse-engineering
